title: SDO/HMI quick-look photospheric continuum intensity
product: HMI Intensitygram – Gray (HMII), full disk, with limb darkening
instrument: Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI), Solar Dynamics Observatory
producer: NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory and HMI science team
display_credit: Courtesy of NASA/SDO and the AIA, EVE, and HMI science teams.
time_evidence: The source labels the frame 2026.11.16_00:11:15_TAI. Subtracting 37 s gives 00:10:38 UTC, matching the browse filename.
spectrum: Continuum estimated from HMI filtergrams near the Fe I 617.3 nm absorption line in visible light.

processing.limb: Sampled 1800 radial profiles about the image centre. Robustly fitted a circle to the outer boundary above 2/255 in the original grayscale quick-look image. Coordinates below use zero-based pixel centres.
processing.crop_resize: Centred the fitted disk and resampled the square crop to 384×384 with Lanczos. Removed the external original black field and timestamp with an 8× antialiased circular alpha mask.
processing.luminance: Source JPEG is native single-channel grayscale. Multiplied the resized 8-bit display values by 1.85 for the web map and copied them to R, G and B, with 8-bit clipping. No gamma remapping or local contrast enhancement. Original limb darkening and sunspot structure retained.
